verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is a digital notarization service, so an audit trail and completion certificate is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack, however, never documents a tamper-evident audit trail or a per-document completion certificate. The HMAC-SHA256 signatures only authenticate webhook payloads, and the Compliance API mention gives no detail about audit records, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can rely on a tamper-evident audit trail and completion certificate for every signed document
